summary:
## Core Philosophy
Phoenix's flashes are **versatile tools**, not just a one-way utility. **Creativity and situational awareness** are key to using them effectively. Always analyze the angle, enemy position, and teammate proximity before choosing which flash to use.

## Advanced Flash Techniques

- **Bank Flash**:
  - **Use Case**: Excels in **1v1 duels** around a corner.
  - **Execution**: Throw the flash against a flat wall adjacent to the angle you're peeking and swing out with it.
  - **Benefit**: You swing with the flash, giving the enemy minimal time to react before they're blind.
  > [!IMPORTANT]
  > This only works on flat surfaces; uneven geometry can cause unpredictable bounces.

- **Reverse Flash**:
  - **Use Case**: Peeking long corridors or when an enemy is **too close** for a standard flash.
  - **Execution**: Turn away from the angle, throw the flash towards it, and then swing into the angle as it pops.
  - **Benefit**: More versatile than the bank flash, covers a wider area, and is safer for teammates behind you.

- **Ground Flash**:
  - **Use Case**: A substitute for the bank flash when a suitable wall isn't available.
  - **Execution**: Look down at the ground near a corner, use your alternate fire (right-click), and swing.
  - **Benefit**: Simulates the pop-flash effect of a bank flash in open areas where bouncing isn't possible.

- **Flash Over Obstacles**:
  - **Use Case**: To blind enemies when you have no information on their positions behind cover (like boxes on a site).
  - **Execution**: Throw the flash high over the obstacle, turn away, and then peek.
  - **Benefit**: Blinds a wide area behind cover without you having to expose yourself.

- **"Unnamed" Jump-Peek Flash**:
  - **Use Case**: To **counteract players who spray** predictable angles when they get blinded.
  - **Execution**: Throw a standard flash, turn away, then jump-peek around the corner as you turn back.
  - **Benefit**: Changes your peeking height and timing, making you a harder target for blind pre-fire.

## Creative & Reactive Plays

- **Counter-Flashing**:
  - If you get blinded by an enemy, immediately throw your own flash at the source and turn away.
  - By the time your vision returns, the enemy will be blind, turning a disadvantage into an opportunity.
  > [!TIP]
  > This is incredibly effective because Phoenix's flashes are instant and don't require an extra key press to activate.

- **Viper's Pit Flash**:
  - As an enemy Viper's ultimate is about to fully form over you, throw a flash straight up into the air.
  - Enemies waiting for the wall to drop will be staring right at the flash and get fully blinded.
